# Win Equipments

> Win Equipments (est. 2008) manufactures compressed air treatment equipment, process chillers and FRP cooling towers at Arasur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, with 1,200+ installations. Tagline: Save Water and Power.

Address: SF No. 4/195 B, Kallangadu, Nadu Arasur, Arasur Post, Coimbatore 641 407, Tamil Nadu, India
Phone: +91 95972 28969, +91 95972 28975
Email: info@winequipments.com

## Product families
- [Compressed air treatment](https://winequipments.com/products/compressed-air-treatment.html): refrigerated and desiccant air dryers, compressed air filters, automatic drain valves, air receiver tanks, aftercoolers
- [Cooling towers](https://winequipments.com/products/cooling-towers.html): round and square FRP cooling towers, closed-circuit cooling towers
- [Process cooling](https://winequipments.com/products/process-cooling.html): industrial process chillers and engineered-to-order chillers
- [All products](https://winequipments.com/products/)
